Password enumeration vulnerability in Liferay Portal 7.4.0 through 7.4.3.119, and older unsupported versions, and Liferay DXP 2024.Q1.1 through 2024.Q1.5, 2023.Q4.0 through 2023.Q4.10, 2023.Q3.1 through 2023.Q3.10, 7.4 GA through update 92, and older unsupported versions allows remote attackers to determine a user’s password even if account lockout is enabled via brute force attack.

Vulnerabilidad de enumeración de contraseñas en Liferay Portal 7.4.0 hasta 7.4.3.119, y versiones anteriores no compatibles, y Liferay DXP 2024.Q1.1 hasta 2024.Q1.5, 2023.Q4.0 hasta 2023.Q4.10, 2023.Q3.1 hasta 2023.Q3.10, 7.4 GA hasta la actualización 92, y versiones anteriores no compatibles, permite a atacantes remotos determinar la contraseña de un usuario incluso si el bloqueo de cuenta está habilitado mediante ataque de fuerza bruta.

A vulnerability was identified in NeuVector, where the enforcer used environment variables CLUSTER_RPC_PORT and CLUSTER_LAN_PORT to generate a command to be executed via popen, without first sanitising their values.


The entry process of the enforcer container is the monitor
 process. When the enforcer container stops, the monitor process checks 
whether the consul subprocess has exited. To perform this check, the 
monitor process uses the popen function to execute a shell command that determines whether the ports used by the consul subprocess are still active.


The values of environment variables CLUSTER_RPC_PORT and CLUSTER_LAN_PORT
 are used directly to compose shell commands via popen without 
validation or sanitization.  This behavior could allow a malicious user 
to inject malicious commands through these variables within the enforcer
 container.

Se identificó una vulnerabilidad en NeuVector, donde el enforcer usó las variables de entorno CLUSTER_RPC_PORT y CLUSTER_LAN_PORT para generar un comando a ser ejecutado vía popen, sin sanitizar primero sus valores.

El proceso de entrada del contenedor del enforcer es el proceso monitor. Cuando el contenedor del enforcer se detiene, el proceso monitor verifica si el subproceso consul ha terminado. Para realizar esta verificación, el proceso monitor usa la función popen para ejecutar un comando de shell que determina si los puertos usados por el subproceso consul aún están activos.

Los valores de las variables de entorno CLUSTER_RPC_PORT y CLUSTER_LAN_PORT son usados directamente para componer comandos de shell vía popen sin validación o sanitización. Este comportamiento podría permitir a un usuario malintencionado inyectar comandos maliciosos a través de estas variables dentro del contenedor del enforcer.

A Path Traversal vulnerability in the tftpsync/add and tftpsync/delete scripts allows a remote attacker on an adjacent network to write or delete files on the filesystem with the privileges of the unprivileged wwwrun user. Although the endpoint is unauthenticated, access is restricted to a list of allowed IP addresses.

Una vulnerabilidad de salto de ruta en los scripts tftpsync/add y tftpsync/delete permite a un atacante remoto en una red adyacente escribir o eliminar archivos en el sistema de archivos con los privilegios del usuario wwwrun sin privilegios. Aunque el endpoint no está autenticado, el acceso está restringido a una lista de direcciones IP permitidas.

A Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability allows attackers to run arbitrary javascript via a reflected XSS issue in the search fields.This issue affects Container suse/manager/5.0/x86_64/server:latest: from ? before 5.0.28-150600.3.36.8; SUSE Manager Server LTS 4.3: from ? before 4.3.88-150400.3.113.5.

Una vulnerabilidad de Neutralización Incorrecta de Etiquetas HTML Relacionadas con Scripts en una Página Web (XSS Básico) permite a los atacantes ejecutar javascript arbitrario a través de un problema de XSS reflejado en los campos de búsqueda. Este problema afecta al Contenedor suse/manager/5.0/x86_64/servidor:latest: desde ? antes de 5.0.28-150600.3.36.8; SUSE Manager Servidor LTS 4.3: desde ? antes de 4.3.88-150400.3.113.5.

By default, Liferay Portal 7.4.0 through 7.4.3.119, and older unsupported versions, and Liferay DXP 2024.Q1.1 through 2024.Q1.5, 2023.Q4.0 through 2023.Q4.10, 2023.Q3.1 through 2023.Q3.10, 7.4 GA through update 92, and older unsupported versions is vulnerable to DNS rebinding attacks, which allows remote attackers to redirect users to arbitrary external URLs. This vulnerability can be mitigated by changing the redirect URL security from IP to domain.

Por defecto, Liferay Portal 7.4.0 hasta 7.4.3.119, y versiones anteriores no compatibles, y Liferay DXP 2024.Q1.1 hasta 2024.Q1.5, 2023.Q4.0 hasta 2023.Q4.10, 2023.Q3.1 hasta 2023.Q3.10, 7.4 GA hasta la actualización 92, y versiones anteriores no compatibles son vulnerables a ataques de reencuadernación de DNS, lo que permite a atacantes remotos redirigir a los usuarios a URL externas arbitrarias. Esta vulnerabilidad puede mitigarse cambiando la seguridad de la URL de redirección de IP a dominio.

Cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the Blogs widget in Liferay Portal 7.4.0 through 7.4.3.111, and older unsupported versions, and Liferay DXP 2023.Q4.0 through 2023.Q4.10, 2023.Q3.1 through 2023.Q3.8, 7.4 GA through update 92, 7.3 GA through update 36, and older unsupported versions allows remote attackers to inject arbitrary web script or HTML via a crafted <iframe> injected into a blog entry's “Content” text field 

The Blogs widget in Liferay DXP does not add the sandbox attribute to <iframe> elements, which allows remote attackers to access the parent page via scripts and links in the frame page.

Vulnerabilidad de cross-site scripting (XSS) en el widget de Blogs en Liferay Portal 7.4.0 hasta 7.4.3.111, y versiones anteriores no compatibles, y Liferay DXP 2023.Q4.0 hasta 2023.Q4.10, 2023.Q3.1 hasta 2023.Q3.8, 7.4 GA hasta la actualización 92, 7.3 GA hasta la actualización 36, y versiones anteriores no compatibles, permite a atacantes remotos inyectar scripts web o HTML arbitrarios a través de un <iframe> manipulado inyectado en el campo de texto 'Content' de una entrada de blog.

El widget de Blogs en Liferay DXP no añade el atributo sandbox a los elementos <iframe>, lo que permite a atacantes remotos acceder a la página padre a través de scripts y enlaces en la página del marco.

Nagios XI versions prior to 2011R1.9 contain privilege escalation vulnerabilities in the scripts that install or update system crontab entries. Due to time-of-check/time-of-use race conditions and missing synchronization or final-path validation, a local low-privileged user could manipulate filesystem state during crontab installation to influence the files or commands executed with elevated privileges, resulting in execution with higher privileges.

Versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a 2011R1.9 contienen vulnerabilidades de escalada de privilegios en los scripts que instalan o actualizan entradas de crontab del sistema. Debido a condiciones de carrera de tiempo de verificación/tiempo de uso y la falta de sincronización o validación de ruta final, un usuario local con pocos privilegios podría manipular el estado del sistema de archivos durante la instalación de crontab para influir en los archivos o comandos ejecutados con privilegios elevados, lo que resulta en la ejecución con privilegios superiores.

Nagios XI versions prior to 2011R1.9 are vulnerable to cross-site scripting (XSS) via the handling of the "backend_url" JavaScript link. Insufficient validation or escaping of user-supplied input may allow an attacker to inject and execute arbitrary script in the context of a victim's browser.

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a 2011R1.9 son vulnerables a cross-site scripting (XSS) a través del manejo del enlace JavaScript 'backend_url'. La validación o el escape insuficientes de la entrada proporcionada por el usuario pueden permitir a un atacante inyectar y ejecutar scripts arbitrarios en el contexto del navegador de una víctima.

Una validación o escape insuficiente de la entrada proporcionada por el usuario puede permitir a un atacante inyectar y ejecutar scripts arbitrarios en el contexto del navegador de una víctima.

Nagios XI versions prior to 2012R1.3 contain a SQL injection vulnerability in the legacy Core Configuration Manager (CCM) interface. Authenticated users could manipulate SQL queries by supplying crafted input to specific CCM parameters, potentially allowing access to configuration data stored in the application database. Successful exploitation could disclose or modify notification data and, in some cases, impact the application database more broadly.

Versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a 2012R1.3 contienen una vulnerabilidad de inyección SQL en la interfaz del gestor de configuración central (CCM) heredado. Usuarios autenticados podrían manipular consultas SQL al proporcionar entradas manipuladas a parámetros específicos del CCM, lo que podría permitir el acceso a datos de configuración almacenados en la base de datos de la aplicación. La explotación exitosa podría divulgar o modificar datos de notificación y, en algunos casos, impactar la base de datos de la aplicación de manera más amplia.

Nagios XI versions prior to 2012R1.6 contain a reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the dashboard dashlet AJAX load functionality. Insufficient validation or escaping of user-supplied input may allow an attacker to inject and execute arbitrary script in the context of a victim's browser.

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a 2012R1.6 contienen una vulnerabilidad de cross-site scripting (XSS) reflejado en la funcionalidad de carga AJAX del dashlet del panel de control. La validación o el escape insuficientes de la entrada proporcionada por el usuario pueden permitir a un atacante inyectar y ejecutar scripts arbitrarios en el contexto del navegador de una víctima.

Nagios XI versions prior to 2012R1.6 contain an authorization flaw in the Auto-Discovery functionality. Users with read-only roles could directly reach Auto-Discovery endpoints and pages that should require elevated permissions, exposing discovery results and allowing unintended access to discovery operations.

Versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a 2012R1.6 contienen una falla de autorización en la funcionalidad de Auto-Discovery. Usuarios con roles de solo lectura podían acceder directamente a los endpoints y páginas de Auto-Discovery que deberían requerir permisos elevados, exponiendo los resultados del descubrimiento y permitiendo acceso no intencionado a las operaciones de descubrimiento.

Nagios XI versions prior to 2012R1.6 contain a shell command injection vulnerability in the Auto-Discovery tool. User-controlled input is passed to a shell without adequate sanitation or argument quoting, allowing an authenticated user with access to discovery functionality to execute arbitrary commands with the privileges of the application service.

Versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a 2012R1.6 contienen una vulnerabilidad de inyección de comandos de shell en la herramienta Auto-Discovery. La entrada controlada por el usuario se pasa a un shell sin saneamiento adecuado o entrecomillado de argumentos, permitiendo a un usuario autenticado con acceso a la funcionalidad de descubrimiento ejecutar comandos arbitrarios con los privilegios del servicio de la aplicación.

modules: Auto-Discovery tool – shell invocation / wrapper scripts

descriptions.value: Nagios Log Server versions prior to 1.4.2 are vulnerable to cross-site scripting (XSS) in the Dashboards section when rendering log entries in the Logs table. Untrusted log content was not safely encoded for the output context, allowing attacker-controlled data present in logs to execute script in the victim’s browser within the application origin.

Las versiones de Nagios Log Server anteriores a la 1.4.2 son vulnerables a cross-site scripting (XSS) en la sección de Dashboards al renderizar entradas de registro en la tabla de Registros. El contenido de registro no confiable no se codificó de forma segura para el contexto de salida, permitiendo que datos controlados por el atacante presentes en los registros ejecuten scripts en el navegador de la víctima dentro del origen de la aplicación.

Nagios XI versions prior to 5.2.4 contain a SQL injection vulnerability in the notification search functionality. User-supplied search parameters were incorporated into SQL statements without adequate parameterization or sanitation, allowing an authenticated user to manipulate database queries. Successful exploitation could disclose or modify notification data and, in some cases, impact the application database more broadly.

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a la 5.2.4 contienen una vulnerabilidad de inyección SQL en la funcionalidad de búsqueda de notificaciones. Los parámetros de búsqueda proporcionados por el usuario se incorporaron en sentencias SQL sin una parametrización o saneamiento adecuados, permitiendo a un usuario autenticado manipular consultas de la base de datos. La explotación exitosa podría divulgar o modificar datos de notificación y, en algunos casos, impactar la base de datos de la aplicación de manera más amplia.

modules: Web UI / API – Notification search endpoint & query builder

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a la 5.4.13 son vulnerables a cross-site scripting (XSS) a través de la página Views de la interfaz web. La validación o el escape insuficientes de la entrada proporcionada por el usuario pueden permitir a un atacante inyectar y ejecutar scripts arbitrarios en el contexto del navegador de una víctima.

Nagios XI versions prior to 5.4.13 contain a remote code execution vulnerability in the Component Download page. The download/import handler used unsafe command construction with attacker-controlled input and lacked sufficient validation and output encoding, allowing an authenticated user to inject commands or otherwise execute arbitrary code with the privileges of the application service.

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a la 5.4.13 contienen una vulnerabilidad de ejecución remota de código en la página de Descarga de Componentes. El gestor de descarga/importación utilizaba una construcción de comandos insegura con entrada controlada por el atacante y carecía de validación y codificación de salida suficientes, lo que permitía a un usuario autenticado inyectar comandos o, de otro modo, ejecutar código arbitrario con los privilegios del servicio de la aplicación.

modules: Web UI – Component Download page (download/import handler)

descriptions.value: Nagios XI versions prior to 5.5.7 contain a privilege escalation vulnerability in the MRTG graphing component. MRTG-related processes/scripts executed with excessive privileges, allowing a local attacker with limited system access to abuse file/command execution paths or writable resources to gain elevated privileges.

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a la 5.5.7 contienen una vulnerabilidad de escalada de privilegios en el componente de gráficos MRTG. Los procesos/scripts relacionados con MRTG ejecutados con privilegios excesivos, permitiendo a un atacante local con acceso limitado al sistema abusar de las rutas de ejecución de archivos/comandos o de recursos escribibles para obtener privilegios elevados.

Nagios XI versions prior to 5.6.14 contain an authenticated remote command execution vulnerability in the CCM command_test.php script. Insufficient validation of the `address` parameter allows an authenticated user with access to the Core Config Manager to inject shell metacharacters that are incorporated into backend command invocations. Successful exploitation enables arbitrary command execution with the privileges of the Nagios XI web application user and may be leveraged to execute commands on the underlying XI host, modify system configuration, or fully compromise the host.

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a la 5.6.14 contienen una vulnerabilidad de ejecución remota de comandos autenticada en el script CCM command_test.PHP. La validación insuficiente del parámetro 'address' permite a un usuario autenticado con acceso al Core Config Manager inyectar metacaracteres de shell que se incorporan en las invocaciones de comandos de backend. La explotación exitosa permite la ejecución arbitraria de comandos con los privilegios del usuario de la aplicación web de Nagios XI y puede aprovecharse para ejecutar comandos en el host XI subyacente, modificar la configuración del sistema o comprometer completamente el host.

Nagios XI versions prior to 5.6.14 contain a post-authentication SQL injection vulnerability in the SNMP Trap Interface page. Exploitation requires an account with administrative privileges to access the affected interface. A user with administrative access could supply crafted input that is not properly sanitized, allowing SQL injection that may lead to unauthorized disclosure or modification of application data or execution of arbitrary SQL commands against the backend database.

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a la 5.6.14 contienen una vulnerabilidad de inyección SQL de post-autenticación en la página de Interfaz de Trampas SNMP. La explotación requiere una cuenta con privilegios administrativos para acceder a la interfaz afectada. Un usuario con acceso administrativo podría proporcionar entrada manipulada que no está correctamente saneada, permitiendo la inyección SQL que puede conducir a la divulgación o modificación no autorizada de datos de la aplicación o a la ejecución de comandos SQL arbitrarios contra la base de datos de backend.

Nagios Log Server versions prior to 2.1.6 contain cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerabilities via the web interface on the Create User, Edit User, and Manage Host Lists pages. Insufficient validation or escaping of user-supplied input may allow an attacker to inject and execute arbitrary script in the context of a victim's browser.

Nagios Log Server versiones anteriores a 2.1.6 contienen vulnerabilidades de cross-site scripting (XSS) a través de la interfaz web en las páginas Crear Usuario, Editar Usuario y Administrar Listas de Hosts. La validación o el escape insuficientes de la entrada proporcionada por el usuario pueden permitir a un atacante inyectar y ejecutar scripts arbitrarios en el contexto del navegador de una víctima.

modules: Web UI – Manage Host Lists page

descriptions.value: Nagios XI versions prior to 5.6.11 contain unauthenticated vulnerabilities in the Highcharts local exporting tool. Crafted export requests could (1) inject script into exported/returned content due to insufficient output encoding (XSS), and (2) cause the server to fetch attacker-specified URLs (SSRF), potentially accessing internal network resources. An unauthenticated remote attacker can leverage these issues to execute script in a user's browser when the exported content is viewed and to disclose sensitive information reachable from the export server via SSRF.

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a la 5.6.11 contienen vulnerabilidades no autenticadas en la herramienta de exportación local de Highcharts. Solicitudes de exportación manipuladas podrían (1) inyectar scripts en el contenido exportado/devuelto debido a una codificación de salida insuficiente (XSS), y (2) hacer que el servidor obtenga URLs especificadas por el atacante (SSRF), accediendo potencialmente a recursos de red internos. Un atacante remoto no autenticado puede aprovechar estos problemas para ejecutar scripts en el navegador de un usuario cuando se visualiza el contenido exportado y para divulgar información sensible accesible desde el servidor de exportación a través de SSRF.

modules: Highcharts local exporting tool / export server (render service & parameter handlers)

descriptions.value: Nagios XI versions prior to 5.7.2 allow PHP files to be uploaded to the Audio Import directory and executed from that location. The upload handler did not properly restrict file types or enforce storage outside of the webroot, and the web server permitted execution within the upload directory. An authenticated attacker with access to the audio import feature could upload a crafted PHP file and then request it to achieve remote code execution with the privileges of the application service.

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a la 5.7.2 permiten que se suban archivos PHP al directorio de Importación de Audio y se ejecuten desde esa ubicación. El gestor de subida no restringía adecuadamente los tipos de archivo ni forzaba el almacenamiento fuera del webroot, y el servidor web permitía la ejecución dentro del directorio de subida. Un atacante autenticado con acceso a la función de importación de audio podría subir un archivo PHP manipulado y luego solicitarlo para lograr la ejecución remota de código con los privilegios del servicio de la aplicación.

modules: Audio import directory / upload handler (web UI/API)
Web server configuration for upload directory execution

descriptions.value: Nagios XI versions prior to 5.7.2 are vulnerable to cross-site scripting (XSS) via the background color settings in Dashboards. Insufficient validation or escaping of user-supplied input may allow an attacker to inject and execute arbitrary script in the context of a victim's browser.

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a la 5.7.2 son vulnerables a cross-site scripting (XSS) a través de la configuración del color de fondo en los Paneles de Control. Una validación o escape insuficiente de la entrada proporcionada por el usuario puede permitir a un atacante inyectar y ejecutar scripts arbitrarios en el contexto del navegador de una víctima.

modules: Web UI – Dashboards: background color field/rendering

descriptions.value: Nagios XI versions prior to 5.7.2 are vulnerable to cross-site scripting (XSS) via the BPI (Business Process Intelligence) component’s Config Management and Edit Config page. Insufficient validation or escaping of user-supplied input may allow an attacker to inject and execute arbitrary script in the context of a victim's browser.

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a la 5.7.2 son vulnerables a cross-site scripting (XSS) a través de las páginas de Gestión de Configuración y Edición de Configuración del componente BPI (Business Process Intelligence). La validación o el escape insuficientes de la entrada proporcionada por el usuario pueden permitir a un atacante inyectar y ejecutar scripts arbitrarios en el contexto del navegador de una víctima.

modules: BPI (Business Process Intelligence) component – Config Management > Edit Config page

descriptions.value: Nagios XI versions prior to 5.7.3 are vulnerable to cross-site scripting (XSS) via the Manage Users page of the Admin interface. Insufficient validation or escaping of user-supplied input may allow an attacker to inject and execute arbitrary script in the context of a victim's browser.

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a la 5.7.3 son vulnerables a cross-site scripting (XSS) a través de la página 'Manage Users' de la interfaz de administración. La validación o el escape insuficientes de la entrada proporcionada por el usuario pueden permitir a un atacante inyectar y ejecutar scripts arbitrarios en el contexto del navegador de una víctima.

modules: Web UI – Admin → Manage Users (user list/detail renderers)

descriptions.value: Nagios XI versions prior to 5.7.3 contain a command injection vulnerability in the report PDF download/export functionality. User-supplied values used in the PDF generation pipeline or the wrapper that invokes offline/pdf helper utilities were insufficiently validated or improperly escaped, allowing an authenticated attacker who can trigger PDF exports to inject shell metacharacters or arguments.

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a la 5.7.3 contienen una vulnerabilidad de inyección de comandos en la funcionalidad de descarga/exportación de informes PDF. Los valores proporcionados por el usuario utilizados en la cadena de generación de PDF o el envoltorio que invoca las utilidades auxiliares sin conexión/PDF no fueron validados suficientemente o se escaparon incorrectamente, permitiendo a un atacante autenticado que puede activar exportaciones de PDF inyectar metacaracteres o argumentos de shell.

modules: Web UI – Report PDF Download handler (export/pdf generation subsystem)

descriptions.value: Nagios XI versions prior to 5.7.3 contain a privilege escalation vulnerability in the getprofile.sh helper script. The script performed profile retrieval and initialization routines using insecure file/command handling and insufficient validation of attacker-controlled inputs, and in some deployments executed with elevated privileges. A local attacker with low-level access could exploit these weaknesses to cause the script to execute arbitrary commands or modify privileged files, resulting in privilege escalation.

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a la 5.7.3 contienen una vulnerabilidad de escalada de privilegios en el script auxiliar getprofile.sh. El script realizaba rutinas de recuperación e inicialización de perfiles utilizando un manejo inseguro de archivos/comandos y una validación insuficiente de las entradas controladas por el atacante, y en algunas implementaciones se ejecutaba con privilegios elevados. Un atacante local con acceso de bajo nivel podría explotar estas debilidades para hacer que el script ejecute comandos arbitrarios o modifique archivos privilegiados, lo que resultaría en una escalada de privilegios.

modules: Installation / helper scripts – scripts/getprofile.sh (profile retrieval/initialization script)

descriptions.value: Nagios XI versions prior to 5.7.5 contain a SQL injection vulnerability in the SNMP Trap Interface edit page. Exploitation requires an account with administrative privileges to access the affected interface. A user with administrative access could supply crafted input that is not properly sanitized, allowing SQL injection that may lead to unauthorized disclosure or modification of application data or execution of arbitrary SQL commands against the backend database.

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a la 5.7.5 contienen una vulnerabilidad de inyección SQL en la página de edición de la interfaz de trampas SNMP. La explotación requiere una cuenta con privilegios administrativos para acceder a la interfaz afectada. Un usuario con acceso administrativo podría proporcionar una entrada manipulada que no está correctamente saneada, permitiendo la inyección SQL que puede conducir a la divulgación o modificación no autorizada de datos de la aplicación o a la ejecución de comandos SQL arbitrarios contra la base de datos de backend.

modules: Web UI – SNMP Trap Interface: edit page / parameter handler

Insufficient validation or escaping of user-supplied input may allow an attacker to inject and execute arbitrary script in the context of a victim's browser.

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a la 5.8.9 son vulnerables a cross-site scripting (XSS) en el componente BPI a través del campo URL de información. La validación o el escape insuficientes de la entrada proporcionada por el usuario pueden permitir a un atacante inyectar y ejecutar script arbitrario en el contexto del navegador de una víctima.

modules: BPI (Business Process Intelligence) – Config fields: info URL (listing/detail renderers)

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a la 5.8.9 son vulnerables a cross-site scripting (XSS) a través del texto de error de Apply Configuration. La validación o el escape insuficientes de la entrada proporcionada por el usuario pueden permitir a un atacante inyectar y ejecutar scripts arbitrarios en el contexto del navegador de una víctima.

modules: Core Config Manager (CCM) – Apply Configuration: error output renderer (command name display)

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a la 5.8.9 son vulnerables a cross-site scripting (XSS) en la función de comprobación de actualizaciones. La validación o el escape insuficientes de la entrada proporcionada por el usuario pueden permitir a un atacante inyectar y ejecutar scripts arbitrarios en el contexto del navegador de una víctima.

modules: Web UI – Update Check / Update Status (stored fields displayed in update notifications/views)

descriptions.value: Nagios XI versions prior to 5.11.3 are vulnerable to cross-site scripting (XSS) and cross-site request forgery (CSRF) via the Hypermap Replay component. An attacker can submit crafted input that is not properly validated or escaped, allowing injection of malicious script that executes in the context of a victim's browser (XSS). Additionally, the component does not enforce sufficient anti-CSRF protections on state-changing operations, enabling an attacker to induce authenticated users to perform unwanted actions.

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a la 5.11.3 son vulnerables a cross-site scripting (XSS) y Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) a través del componente Hypermap Replay. Un atacante puede enviar una entrada manipulada que no está correctamente validada o escapada, permitiendo la inyección de scripts maliciosos que se ejecutan en el contexto del navegador de una víctima (XSS). Además, el componente no aplica protecciones anti-CSRF suficientes en operaciones que cambian el estado, lo que permite a un atacante inducir a usuarios autenticados a realizar acciones no deseadas.

Nagios Fusion versions prior to 4.2.0 contain a reflected cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the license key configuration flow that can result in execution of attacker-controlled script in the browser of a user who follows a crafted URL. While the application server itself is not directly corrupted by the reflected XSS, the resulting browser compromise can lead to credential/session theft and unauthorized administrative actions.

Versiones de Nagios Fusion anteriores a la 4.2.0 contienen una vulnerabilidad de cross-site scripting (XSS) reflejado en el flujo de configuración de la clave de licencia que puede resultar en la ejecución de scripts controlados por el atacante en el navegador de un usuario que sigue una URL manipulada. Si bien el servidor de aplicaciones en sí no se corrompe directamente por el XSS reflejado, el compromiso resultante del navegador puede conducir al robo de credenciales/sesiones y acciones administrativas no autorizadas.

Nagios Fusion versions prior to 4.2.0 contain a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in the LDAP/AD authentication-server configuration. Unsanitized user input can be stored and later rendered in the administrative UI, causing JavaScript to execute in the browser of any user who views the affected page. An attacker who can add authentication servers via LDAP/AD integration could persist a malicious payload that executes in the context of other users' browsers.

Las versiones de Nagios Fusion anteriores a la 4.2.0 contienen una vulnerabilidad de cross-site scripting (XSS) almacenada en la configuración del servidor de autenticación LDAP/AD. La entrada de usuario no saneada puede almacenarse y luego renderizarse en la interfaz de usuario administrativa, haciendo que JavaScript se ejecute en el navegador de cualquier usuario que vea la página afectada. Un atacante que pueda añadir servidores de autenticación a través de la integración LDAP/AD podría persistir una carga útil maliciosa que se ejecute en el contexto de los navegadores de otros usuarios.

Nagios Fusion versions prior to 4.2.0 contain a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability when adding or configuring Email Settings. Unsanitized user input can be stored and later rendered in the administrative UI, causing JavaScript to execute in the browser of any user who views the affected page. An attacker who can add or modify SMTP/email settings or manipulate the sendmail configuration fields could persist a malicious payload that executes in the context of other users' browsers.

Las versiones de Nagios Fusion anteriores a la 4.2.0 contienen una vulnerabilidad de cross-site scripting (XSS) almacenada al añadir o configurar los Ajustes de Correo Electrónico. La entrada de usuario no saneada puede ser almacenada y posteriormente renderizada en la interfaz de usuario administrativa, causando que JavaScript se ejecute en el navegador de cualquier usuario que vea la página afectada. Un atacante que pueda añadir o modificar los ajustes SMTP/de correo electrónico o manipular los campos de configuración de sendmail podría persistir una carga útil maliciosa que se ejecuta en el contexto de los navegadores de otros usuarios.

Nagios XI versions prior to 5.11.3 are vulnerable to cross-site scripting (XSS) via the Bulk Modifications tool. Insufficient validation or escaping of user-supplied input may allow an attacker to inject and execute arbitrary script in the context of a victim's browser.

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a la 5.11.3 son vulnerables a cross-site scripting (XSS) a través de la herramienta de Modificaciones Masivas. Una validación o escape insuficiente de la entrada proporcionada por el usuario puede permitir a un atacante inyectar y ejecutar scripts arbitrarios en el contexto del navegador de una víctima.

Nagios XI versions prior to 5.11.3 are vulnerable to cross-site scripting (XSS) via the Bandwidth Report component. Insufficient validation or escaping of user-supplied input may allow an attacker to inject and execute arbitrary script in the context of a victim's browser.

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a la 5.11.3 son vulnerables a cross-site scripting (XSS) a través del componente Bandwidth Report. La validación o el escape insuficientes de la entrada proporcionada por el usuario pueden permitir a un atacante inyectar y ejecutar scripts arbitrarios en el contexto del navegador de una víctima.

Nagios XI versions prior to 5.11.3 are vulnerable to cross-site scripting (XSS) via the Graph Explorer component. Insufficient validation or escaping of user-supplied input may allow an attacker to inject and execute arbitrary script in the context of a victim's browser.

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a la 5.11.3 son vulnerables a cross-site scripting (XSS) a través del componente Graph Explorer. La validación o el escape insuficientes de la entrada proporcionada por el usuario pueden permitir a un atacante inyectar y ejecutar scripts arbitrarios en el contexto del navegador de una víctima.

Nagios XI versions prior to 2024R1 are vulnerable to cross-site scripting (XSS) via the Graph Explorer component. Insufficient validation or escaping of user-supplied input may allow an attacker to inject and execute arbitrary script in the context of a victim's browser.

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a 2024R1 son vulnerables a cross-site scripting (XSS) a través del componente Graph Explorer. La validación o el escape insuficientes de la entrada proporcionada por el usuario pueden permitir a un atacante inyectar y ejecutar scripts arbitrarios en el contexto del navegador de una víctima.

Nagios XI versions prior to 2024R1 contain a missing access control vulnerability via the Web SSH Terminal. A remote, low-privileged attacker could access or interact with the terminal interface without sufficient authorization, potentially allowing unauthorized command execution or disclosure of sensitive information.

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a 2024R1 contienen una vulnerabilidad de control de acceso faltante a través del Terminal Web SSH. Un atacante remoto con bajos privilegios podría acceder o interactuar con la interfaz del terminal sin la autorización suficiente, lo que podría permitir la ejecución no autorizada de comandos o la divulgación de información sensible.

Nagios XI versions prior to < 2024R1.0.2 are vulnerable to cross-site scripting (XSS) via the Nagios Core Command Expansion page. Insufficient validation or escaping of user-supplied input may allow an attacker to inject and execute arbitrary script in the context of a victim's browser.

Las versiones de Nagios XI anteriores a < 2024R1.0.2 son vulnerables a cross-site scripting (XSS) a través de la página Nagios Core Command Expansion. La validación o el escape insuficientes de la entrada proporcionada por el usuario pueden permitir a un atacante inyectar y ejecutar scripts arbitrarios en el contexto del navegador de una víctima.

Nagios Network Analyzer versions prior to 2024R1 are vulnerable to cross-site scripting (XSS) via the Percentile Calculator menu. Insufficient validation or escaping of user-supplied input may allow an attacker to inject and execute arbitrary script in the context of a victim's browser.

Las versiones de Nagios Network Analyzer anteriores a 2024R1 son vulnerables a cross-site scripting (XSS) a través del menú Calculadora de Percentiles. Una validación o escape insuficiente de la entrada proporcionada por el usuario puede permitir a un atacante inyectar y ejecutar scripts arbitrarios en el contexto del navegador de una víctima.

Nagios Log Server versions prior to 2.1.14 are vulnerable to cross-site scripting (XSS) via the Snapshots Page. Untrusted log content was not safely encoded for the output context, allowing attacker-controlled data present in logs to execute script in the victim’s browser within the application origin.

Las versiones de Nagios Log Server anteriores a la 2.1.14 son vulnerables a cross-site scripting (XSS) a través de la Página de Instantáneas. El contenido de registro no confiable no se codificó de forma segura para el contexto de salida, permitiendo que datos controlados por el atacante presentes en los registros ejecuten scripts en el navegador de la víctima dentro del origen de la aplicación.

Nagios Log Server versions prior to 2024R1 contain an incorrect authorization vulnerability. Users who lacked the required API permission were nevertheless able to invoke API endpoints, resulting in unintended access to data and actions exposed via the API. This incorrect authorization check could allow authenticated but non-privileged users to read or modify resources beyond their intended rights.

Las versiones de Nagios Log Server anteriores a 2024R1 contienen una vulnerabilidad de autorización incorrecta. Los usuarios que carecían del permiso de API requerido, sin embargo, pudieron invocar puntos finales de API, lo que resultó en un acceso no intencionado a datos y acciones expuestos a través de la API. Esta verificación de autorización incorrecta podría permitir a usuarios autenticados pero no privilegiados leer o modificar recursos más allá de sus derechos previstos.

modules: Web API / Authorization and Permission Enforcement Layer

descriptions.value: Nagios Log Server versions prior to 2024R1 are vulnerable to cross-site scripting (XSS) via the Create User function. Insufficient validation or escaping of user-supplied input may allow an attacker to inject and execute arbitrary script in the context of a victim's browser.

Las versiones de Nagios Log Server anteriores a 2024R1 son vulnerables a cross-site scripting (XSS) a través de la función Crear Usuario. Una validación o escape insuficiente de la entrada proporcionada por el usuario puede permitir a un atacante inyectar y ejecutar scripts arbitrarios en el contexto del navegador de una víctima.

Anheng Mingyu Operation and Maintenance Audit and Risk Control System up to 2023-08-10 contains a server-side request forgery (SSRF) vulnerability in the xmlrpc.sock handler. The product accepts specially crafted XML-RPC requests that can be used to instruct the server to connect to internal unix socket RPC endpoints and perform privileged XML-RPC methods. An attacker able to send such requests can invoke administrative RPC methods via the unix socket interface to create arbitrary user accounts on the system, resulting in account creation and potential takeover of the bastion host. VulnCheck has observed this vulnerability being exploited in the wild as of 2025-10-30 at 00:30:17.837319 UTC.

El Sistema de Auditoría y Control de Riesgos de Operación y Mantenimiento Anheng Mingyu hasta el 2023-08-10 contiene una vulnerabilidad de Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF) en el gestor xmlrpc.sock. El producto acepta peticiones XML-RPC especialmente diseñadas que pueden usarse para instruir al servidor a conectarse a puntos finales RPC de sockets unix internos y realizar métodos XML-RPC privilegiados. Un atacante capaz de enviar dichas peticiones puede invocar métodos RPC administrativos a través de la interfaz de socket unix para crear cuentas de usuario arbitrarias en el sistema, lo que resulta en la creación de cuentas y una posible toma de control del host bastión. VulnCheck ha observado esta vulnerabilidad siendo explotada en la naturaleza a partir del 30-10-2025 a las 00:30:17.837319 UTC.

descriptions.value: A flaw has been found in LMCache up to 0.5.4. This affects the function hex_hash_to_int16 of the file lmcache/integration/vllm/utils.py of the component KV Cache Handler. Executing a manipulation can lead to use of weak hash. The attack needs to be launched locally. The attack requires a high level of complexity. It is indicated that the exploitability is difficult. The exploit has been published and may be used. Upgrading to version 0.5.5 is able to mitigate this issue. This patch is called ce08eea76ce5898200efee55f4932fd07a7cabeb. It is suggested to upgrade the affected component. A contributor of the project confirms: "hex_hash_to_int16() was introduced in 0.3.1 (PR #882, commit f5174701). It is not present in 0.3.0, and it is still present in 0.4.7 through 0.5.4."

Se ha encontrado una vulnerabilidad en LMCache hasta 0.4.6. Esto afecta a la función hex_hash_to_int16 del archivo lmcache/integration/vllm/utils.py del componente KV Cache Gestor. La ejecución de una manipulación puede llevar al uso de un hash débil. El ataque debe lanzarse localmente. El ataque requiere un alto nivel de complejidad. Se indica que la explotabilidad es difícil. El exploit ha sido publicado y puede ser utilizado. La pull request para solucionar este problema espera ser aceptada.

Authentication bypass by assumed-immutable data in Microsoft Identity Web allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

Dell Alienware Command Center (AWCC), versions prior to 6.14.54.0, contain a Least Privilege Violation vulnerability. A low privileged attacker with local access could potentially exploit this vulnerability, leading to Elevation of Privilege and Denial of Service.
A heap buffer overflow in the stbl_AddSize function (isomedia/stbl_write.c) of GPAC MP4Box v2.4 allows attackers to cause a Denial of Service (DoS) via supplying a crafted MP4 file.

GPAC MP4Box v2.4 was discovered to contain a floating point exception in the gf_parse_lfrac function (utils/error.c). Processing a crafted MP4 file containing a zero-denominator fraction string causes gf_parse_lfrac() to divide by zero, terminating the process with SIGFPE.

IBM i 7.3, 7.4, 7.5, and 7.6 is vulnerable to an authenticated attacker elevating their privilege. A bad actor could exploit this vulnerability to perform operations with QSECOFR/Root authority on the system.

A flaw was found in libtirpc. A remote attacker can exploit this vulnerability by sending specially crafted PMAPPROC_DUMP replies to a client application that uses the pmap_getmaps() function against an attacker-controlled host. This unbounded decoding can lead to excessive memory and CPU allocation, causing the client process to experience a Denial of Service (DoS) due to resource exhaustion.

A flaw was found in libarchive. An attacker can cause a Denial of Service (DoS) or potential information disclosure due to a use-after-free vulnerability, which occurs when a program reads memory that has already been released. This issue arises when the archive_entry_copy_mac_metadata() function deallocates an internal buffer before completing a data copy. An attacker who can supply input to an application utilizing this function can trigger the flaw to crash the application or read uninitialized memory data.

The EU VAT Assistant for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'vat_number' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.1.30.260413 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. The stored payload executes in the administrator's browser context when reviewing an order via WooCommerce → Orders → Edit Order, enabling privilege escalation up to and including full site takeover via rogue administrator account creation.

The LearnPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to PHP Object Injection in versions up to, and including, 4.4.10 via deserialization of untrusted input from the 'checkout-email' request parameter during the checkout AJAX action. The value is passed through sanitize_text_field(), which does not strip serialized object syntax, then stored in the LearnPress session table and later fed to LP_Helper::maybe_unserialize() → unserialize() (without an allowed_classes restriction) by LP_Session_Handler::get() on subsequent requests. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to inject a PHP Object.

descriptions.value: The Welcart e-Commerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to generic SQL Injection via the 'wp_usces_order_old (JSON fields searchSql / searchSkuSql)' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 2.12.4 due to insufficient escaping on the user supplied parameter and lack of sufficient preparation on the existing SQL query. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with editor-level access and above, to append additional SQL queries into already existing queries that can be used to extract sensitive information from the database.

The WP Booking System – Booking Calendar plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 2.1.0.3 This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to read the stored notification email body of any booking by iterating booking_id and email_log_id, exposing customer PII including names, email addresses, phone numbers, messages, and booking dates intended to be visible only to administrators. This is exploitable by any Subscriber-level user because admin_init fires on profile.php, a wp-admin page accessible to all authenticated users.

The WP Booking System – Booking Calendar plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Sensitive Information Exposure in all versions up to, and including, 2.1.0.3 via the 'id' parameter. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to extract private per-event booking descriptions and booking IDs from any calendar managed by the site.

The WP Booking System – Booking Calendar plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to authorization bypass in all versions up to, and including, 2.1.0.3 This is due to the plugin not properly verifying that a user is authorized to perform an action. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to grant themselves and arbitrary other users edit access to every booking form on the site by overwriting the user_permission meta that governs the plugin's own access-control list. Exploitation requires the attacker to have already been delegated edit rights on at least one booking form, as this delegation both downgrades the submenu capability to 'read' (making the edit page accessible) and allows them to harvest a valid wpbs_edit_form nonce that will pass validation against any other form_id.

The xSpeed Cache: AI-Powered Performance Hub with MCP, Caching & CDN plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the 'content' parameter in all versions up to, and including, 1.4.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. The Post Export Import with Media plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Directory Traversal in all versions up to, and including, 1.17.2 via the 'theme_slug' parameter. Exploitation requires the peiwm_enable_admin_download_buttons feature to be enabled in the plugin settings.

The Themify Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via 'visible' Shortcode Attribute in all versions up to, and including, 7.8.2 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with contributor-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This vulnerability is only exploitable when the 'slider' custom post type is active, which is satisfied automatically when the plugin is paired with a Themify theme or any other plugin that registers the 'slider' CPT.

The Tutor LMS – eLearning and online course solution plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Insecure Direct Object Reference in all versions up to, and including, 4.1.0 via the 'ID' parameter due to missing validation on a user controlled key. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with author-level access and above, to modify arbitrary courses created by other instructors — overwriting their title, content, and status — and reassign ownership of those courses to themselves. This is possible because Input::sanitize_array() preserves attacker-supplied POST keys (including 'ID') without stripping them, and WordPress interprets a non-empty ID in the wp_insert_post() argument array as an update to the existing post rather than a new insert.

descriptions.value: The User Registration & Membership plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary Shortcode Execution in versions up to, and including, 5.2.8 This is due to insufficient input sanitization in the 'referrer_url' branch of UR_Smart_Tags::process(), where the attacker-controlled HTTP_REFERER header is only passed through sanitize_text_field() — which does not strip WordPress shortcode delimiters — before being substituted into a Content Restriction message that is subsequently executed via apply_shortcodes()/do_shortcode(). This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary registered shortcodes on any restricted page whose message uses the supported {{referrer_url}} smart tag.

descriptions.value: The User Registration & Membership – Free & Paid Memberships, Subscriptions, Content Restriction, User Profile, Custom User Registration & Login Builder plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Cross-Site Request Forgery in all versions up to, and including, 5.2.8 This is due to missing or incorrect nonce validation on the trigger_bulk_action function. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to force administrators to approve pending user registrations or deny arbitrary user accounts, locking targeted users out of the site via a forged request granted they can trick a site administrator into performing an action such as clicking on a link. An attacker can bypass the earlier nonce check in trigger_query_actions() by supplying an empty new_role parameter, which causes that handler to return early and cede control to the unprotected trigger_bulk_action() handler; the exit() call at the end of that handler additionally prevents WordPress core's own bulk-users nonce validation from executing.

descriptions.value: The Ukr-To-Lat WordPress plugin through 1.3.5 does not sanitize and escape a term name before using it in a SQL query, allowing users with Contributor-level access and above to perform SQL injection attacks.

The Contact Form 7 Signature Addon WordPress plugin through 4.2.2 does not sanitize a signature field value before building an email attachment path from it, allowing unauthenticated users to attach arbitrary files (bounded to wp-content on current Contact Form 7) to a form's outgoing email via path traversal; when a form is configured to email a copy to a submitter-controlled address, the attacker can read the targeted file.

The WP Data Access  WordPress plugin before 5.5.88 does not have authorisation and CSRF checks in one of its actions, allowing any authenticated user, such as a subscriber, to make the server open connections to arbitrary hosts and ports, including internal ones, and read back the outcome.

The WP User Manager  WordPress plugin before 2.9.20 does not roll back the WordPress account it creates during payment-gated registration when the subsequent payment step fails, allowing unauthenticated users to create functional accounts without completing payment.

The ACF Frontend Admin by DynamiApps WordPress plugin through 3.29.13 does not perform a capability check on one of its form-submission actions before writing submitted values into the site's global ACF options store, allowing unauthenticated visitors to overwrite site-wide option values via a public form.

The ACF Frontend Admin by DynamiApps WordPress plugin through 3.29.13 does not restrict which PHP classes may be instantiated when it deserialises stored post content that is rendered on public-facing pages, allowing high-privilege users such as administrators to inject a PHP object which, given a suitable POP chain in another installed ACF Frontend Admin by DynamiApps WordPress plugin through 3.29.13 or in WordPress core, can be leveraged to achieve remote code execution.

The BSK PDF Manager WordPress plugin through 3.8.1 does not properly sanitise and escape a parameter before using it in a SQL statement, which could allow authenticated users with contributor-level access and above to perform SQL injection attacks and read sensitive data such as administrator password hashes from the database.

The Patreon WordPress plugin before 1.10.0 does not perform an authorization check on some of its functionality, allowing unauthenticated users to enumerate the names of terms in any taxonomy, including non-public taxonomies that WordPress does not expose on the front end.

The Patreon WordPress plugin before 1.10.0 does not validate a user-supplied redirect destination before redirecting, allowing unauthenticated attackers to redirect visitors to an arbitrary external URL through a crafted link, which is useful for phishing.

The Patreon WordPress plugin before 1.10.0 does not verify a nonce when connecting the site to a Patreon account, allowing attackers to make a logged-in administrator re-link the integration to an attacker-controlled account via a crafted request (CSRF), taking over the site's Patreon integration.

The ThirstyAffiliates  WordPress plugin before 3.12.1 does not check the status or type of the object requested by its link redirect tracking handler, allowing unauthenticated attackers to disclose the destination URLs of unpublished affiliate links and to record fabricated click statistics.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Heateor Support Fancy Comments WordPress fancy-facebook-comments allows Reflected XSS.This issue affects Fancy Comments WordPress: from n/a through 1.2.21.

The weForms – Easy Drag & Drop Contact Form Builder For WordPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to limited media file deletion due to insufficient file path validation in the weforms_delete_entry_attachments function in all versions up to, and including, 1.6.28 This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to delete arbitrary media files on the server. Coder 2.3.1 before 2.14.4, 2.15.x before 2.15.3, and 2.16.0 before 2.16.1 contains an open redirect vulnerability in the login page because the redirect query parameter is improperly sanitized. Coder before 2.23.0 contains a session expiration bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to retain access after OIDC token expiry when no refresh token is issued. Users can keep their APIKey cookie active through regular use, extending it every 24 hours to access Coder indefinitely after losing OIDC authorization.

Missing Authorization vulnerability in Cozy Vision Technologies Pvt. Ltd. SMS Alert Order Notifications sms-alert allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels.This issue affects SMS Alert Order Notifications: from n/a through 4.0.1.

FreeRDP versions from 2.0.0 before 3.32.0 contain a heap out-of-bounds write in the server hash-callback NTLM path that fails to validate the MIC offset. Unauthenticated attackers can send a crafted AUTHENTICATE_MESSAGE with a backward session-key offset and MIC offset to write 16 zero bytes beyond the allocation.

FreeRDP from 3.14.1 before 3.32.0 contains an integer underflow in the WinPR BMP writer, where a mismatched stride calculation passes SIZE_MAX - 3 to Stream_Zero for sub-byte images. A malicious RDP clipboard peer can return a crafted 1-bpp BMP processed by clipboard_synthesize_image_format_to_bmp for CF_DIB/CF_DIBV5, crashing the client or causing an out-of-bounds write.

phpMyFAQ 3.2.0-alpha before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows IdP-authenticated users to skip TOTP two-factor authentication through the Keycloak and Entra ID SSO callbacks. Attackers holding a valid or phished IdP identity linked to a 2FA-enabled account can complete the OIDC flow and obtain a fully authenticated session, including administrator accounts.

phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta does not require the current password when changing an account e-mail in the user control panel (UserController::updateData, api/user/data/update), checking only the session and CSRF token. An attacker with a hijacked session can set the e-mail to their own mailbox and use the password-reset flow to take over non-2FA accounts, including superadmin.

phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains a missing authorization vulnerability in GroupController::deleteGroup() that omits privilege-level checks on target groups. Authenticated non-SuperAdmin administrators holding GROUP_DELETE can send a crafted groupId to /admin/api/group/delete to permanently destroy higher-privileged groups and strip members' inherited rights.

phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-beta lacks brute-force lockout in the removeTwofactorConfig() 2FA removal endpoint, allowing authenticated attackers to guess TOTP codes without limit. Attackers holding a hijacked session and CSRF token can repeatedly POST guesses to /api/user/remove-twofactor to permanently disable the victim's 2FA.

phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains an account enumeration vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to confirm registered display names and emails via a distinct HTTP 409 response. Attackers can submit guest comments to the comment create endpoint with candidate user and mail values to link names to emails for targeted phishing.

phpMyFAQ from 4.0.0 before 4.1.9 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows delegated admins lacking the editnews right to modify news by calling PUT /admin/api/news/update, which checks NEWS_DELETE instead of NEWS_EDIT. Attackers holding addnews and delnews can read the update-news CSRF token from their own cookie and rewrite any news item's header, body, author, link and active flag shown on the public front page.

phpMyFAQ from 4.1.0 before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the admin dashboard that allows authenticated users without admin rights to view restricted data. Attackers with any activated account can request /admin/index.php/ to read unpublished FAQ questions, admin edit URLs, recent user identities, and site statistics.

phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-beta contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in UserController::updateUserRights that drops per-right language restrictions when rights are re-granted. Administrators holding USER_EDIT can submit language-scoped rights to the update-rights API, including for themselves, to gain unrestricted FAQ create, edit, and publish access across all languages.

phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha.2 before 4.2.0-beta contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in the group permission API, whose updatePermissions and updateMembers endpoints check held rights without regard to language or category scope and write unrestricted group grants. Non-superadmin administrators holding GROUP_EDIT can grant a group a right they hold only in a narrow scope and self-join it via updateMembers, gaining unrestricted FAQ create, edit, and publish access across all languages and categories.

phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta lacks effective rate limiting on the unauthenticated user/password/update and user/password/reset endpoints. Unauthenticated attackers can send unlimited reset requests to flood a registered user's inbox with reset emails, exhausting mailer and server resources.

phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains a privilege escalation vulnerability in GroupController::saveCategoryRestrictions() that lets delegated administrators assign categories outside their own scope. Category-restricted administrators can POST to /admin/api/group/category-restrictions with out-of-scope or empty categoryIds to grant groups unrestricted category access.

phpMyFAQ 3.2.1 before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability that allows authenticated content authors to inject JavaScript by embedding iframes with data:text/html sources in FAQ or News content. Attackers can bypass the hostless media-host allowlist in FaqHelper::cleanUpContent(), which is rendered via Twig's raw filter, to run phishing interfaces or top-frame redirects for viewers.

phpMyFAQ 3.2.0 before 4.0.0 and 4.0.2 before 4.2.0-beta contains an authentication bypass in its Microsoft Entra ID login flow, which links users by the mutable preferred_username claim and whose AuthEntraId::create() ignores the duplicate-login exception while continuing with the existing local account. Attackers controlling an Entra identity in the configured tenant with a matching preferred_username can take over that local account, including super-admin accounts.

phpMyFAQ from 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in SvgSanitizer that allows FAQ editors to store executable SVG files. Attackers can split script tags around removed tokens like processing instructions so single-pass removal reassembles them, executing script in the application origin when victims open the file.

phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows category-restricted editors to manage attachments of FAQs outside their categories by supplying arbitrary record IDs. Attackers in medium permission mode can send upload or delete requests with a target record_id or attachment ID to tamper with or remove files on unauthorized FAQs.

phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows Keycloak users to take over local accounts by matching preferred_username or email. Attackers controlling a Keycloak identity with a colliding username or unverified email can log in through /auth/keycloak/authorize to bind their subject and gain superadmin privileges.

phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains an improper authorization vulnerability in attachment.php that fails to verify whether an attachment's parent FAQ is published or visible to the requester. Authenticated users with the dlattachment permission can request index.php?action=attachment&id=<ID> to download complete attachment files belonging to draft FAQs.

phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability in the unauthenticated faqs and search API endpoints. Attackers can send concurrent GET requests that load and process all database records into PHP memory, exhausting CPU and memory to crash the server.

phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in isFaqAccessibleForUser() that treats a missing FAQ translation as visible to unauthenticated users. Attackers can send a mismatched Accept-Language header to the comments and attachments API endpoints to read comments and attachment listings of unpublished or ACL-restricted FAQs.

phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in SvgSanitizer that allows users with FAQ_EDIT permission to bypass sanitization using XML DTD custom entities. Attackers can upload an SVG defining an entity that expands to javascript in an anchor href, executing script when viewers click it to hijack admin sessions.

phpMyFAQ 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to read hidden open questions due to an inverted api.onlyPublicQuestions check in OpenQuestionController. Attackers can send GET requests to the /api/v4.0/open-questions endpoint to retrieve non-public moderation or internal questions and their associated usernames.

phpMyFAQ 3.2.0 before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in GET /admin/api/user/data/{userId}, which returns any user's full faquserdata row, including the live TOTP secret, without a SuperAdmin or protected-target check. Delegated administrators with user-management rights can read a SuperAdmin's TOTP secret and generate valid codes to bypass two-factor authentication.

phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the Elasticsearch and OpenSearch administration API endpoints, which do not validate a CSRF token for the create, drop, and import actions. Attackers can lure a user with CONFIGURATION_EDIT permission to a malicious page that triggers these actions, deleting search indexes, forcing re-indexing, or exhausting resources.

phpMyFAQ 4.0.0 before 4.1.9 contains a cross-site request forgery vulnerability in the POST /admin/api/update-database endpoint, which executes database migrations without validating a CSRF token. Attackers can lure a logged-in user with the CONFIGURATION_EDIT permission into submitting a crafted cross-site request, triggering migrations that may impact database integrity or availability.

phpMyFAQ 4.0.0 before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains a broken object-level authorization vulnerability in the PUT /api/v3.1/faq/update endpoint, which checks only the global edit_faq permission and does not verify access to the target FAQ. Authenticated users with edit_faq permission can supply the ID of a restricted FAQ they cannot view to modify its content, bypass moderation, and change its publication state.

phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the deleteUser() API that allows authenticated non-superadmin users with delete_user permission to delete superadmin accounts. Attackers can send a DELETE request to /admin/api/user/delete with a superadmin's userId other than 1, removing administrative access and accountability.

phpMyFAQ before 4.1.9 and 4.2.0-alpha before 4.2.0-beta contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in attachment.php that allows attackers to download attachments of restricted FAQs by bypassing per-record permission checks. Low-privileged users with the dlattachment right, or anonymous users when allowDownloadsForGuests is enabled, can request attachment IDs to retrieve confidential files from restricted FAQs.

phpMyFAQ 4.0.0 before 4.1.9 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability where WebAuthn registration endpoints attach credentials to any account without authentication or challenge validation. Attackers can stage a victim username, submit a forged fmt=none attestation to register a passkey, then log in bypassing passwords and TOTP for account takeover.

Admidio from 5.0.0 before 5.0.16 contains an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in ForumService::saveTopic() that allows authenticated members to modify other users' forum topics. Attackers can replace the topic_uuid parameter in their own topic_save request, reusing their CSRF token, to overwrite the victim topic's title and first post.

Admidio from 5.0.0 before 5.0.16 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows authenticated users to export lists despite export restrictions by requesting mode=pdfl. The groups_roles_export check in modules/groups-roles/lists_show.php omits pdfl, which later runs the pdf export, letting users with list view rights download member lists as PDF files.

Admidio from 5.0.11 before 5.0.16 contains a broken access control vulnerability in modules/inventory/inventory_data.php that allows authenticated users to bypass the inventory_module_enabled restriction. Attackers with any valid login can request the DataTables JSON feed to read every inventory item and keeper names, even when the module is disabled.

Admidio before 5.0.16 contains an information disclosure vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to view role-restricted weblinks because rss/links.php omits the category_view role-visibility filter. Attackers can request the weblinks RSS feed for an organization to retrieve link names, URLs, descriptions, categories, and creator names from restricted LNK categories.

Vikunja 2.3.0 before 2.7.0 contains an improper session validation vulnerability that allows attackers to keep WebSocket access after revocation because handleAuth never checks the JWT sid claim against the sessions table. Attackers holding a stolen access token can open or maintain connections to /api/v2/ws after session deletion or TOTP enrollment, continuing to receive the victim's notification.created pushes, including comment, task and project content.

Vikunja from 1.0.0-rc0 before 2.7.0 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in RecalculateTaskPositions that allows authenticated users with zero accessible projects to write task_positions rows for all tasks instance-wide. Attackers can delete their Inbox after repointing default_project_id, then create empty-filter saved filters to persist cross-tenant references and amplify writes for denial of service.

Vikunja 0.22.0 before 2.7.0 contains an improper access revocation vulnerability that allows removed collaborators to keep receiving project data through webhooks they created. Former collaborators keep receiving task titles and descriptions through their webhook, including content created after their access was revoked.

Vikunja 2.6.0 contains a broken access control flaw in getProjectAccessForUser (pkg/models/project_access.go), which resolves a user's effective project permission as the maximum over the project tree, silently overriding explicit lower-permission shares on sub-projects. A collaborator with write access on a parent project but read-only access to a child project can modify the child project's tasks and content.

Vikunja 0.13.0 before 2.7.0 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows project members with Write permission to delete admin-tier link shares because the delete permission check reads an unloaded share object. Attackers can send DELETE requests to the v1 or v2 projects shares endpoints with sequential share IDs to revoke admin links and invalidate existing share sessions.

Vikunja from 2.2.0 before 2.7.0 contains a permissive CORS configuration that trusts every localhost and 127.0.0.1 port with credentials, even when service.publicurl is set. Attackers controlling a page on any localhost port can send a credentialed request to the token refresh endpoint and read the returned bearer JWT to take over the logged-in user's account.

Fleet before 4.89.0 contains an unbounded recursion vulnerability in Apple MDM enrollment property list parsing that allows unauthenticated attackers to crash the server. Attackers can send a crafted binary plist payload of about 150 bytes to the enrollment endpoints, triggering exponential allocation or infinite recursion that exhausts CPU and memory.

Fleet before 4.83.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust server memory by sending gzip-compressed request bodies. Attackers can send small, highly compressed requests with Content-Encoding: gzip to unauthenticated endpoints that expand during decoding, crashing the entire Fleet instance.

Coder from 2.10.0 before 2.34.8 has an unauthenticated agent debug HTTP server on 127.0.0.1:2113 whose /debug/manifest handler returns the full agent manifest, including template-provided environment variable values. A lower-privileged Unix user or process in the same workspace can query this endpoint to read credentials such as cloud keys or registry tokens.

Coder before 2.29.20, 2.33.0 before 2.33.12, 2.34.0 before 2.34.8, and 2.35.0 before 2.35.4 contains an improper hostname validation flaw in GetWorkspaceProxyByHostname whose SIMILAR TO pattern performs a prefix match, so any domain that is a string prefix of a workspace-proxy access URL is trusted as a proxy. Attackers owning such a domain can lure an authenticated victim to a crafted /api/v2/applications/auth-redirect link, capture the redirected application_connect API key, and replay it to access the victim's workspace apps.

Coder from 2.0.0 before 2.34.8 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in the acl_allow rule of coderd/rbac/policy.rego, which does not verify organization membership for per-user ACL entries, and organization member removal does not scrub those entries. Authenticated users removed from an organization can keep accessing previously granted org-scoped resources such as templates and workspaces via the API.

Coder from 2.30.0 before 2.34.8 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the provisioner daemon DownloadFile gRPC handler that allows authenticated provisioner daemons to download other organizations' cached Terraform module archives. Attackers with an org-scoped provisioner key and a known file UUID can retrieve module source code exposing infrastructure topology or embedded secrets.

Coder from 2.26.0 before 2.34.8 contains an incorrect authorization flaw in the GET /api/v2/workspaces/{id}/acl endpoint, which checks only workspace read access and then fetches group members using an elevated system context. Authenticated users granted workspace use access can query the endpoint to harvest group members' emails, login types, status, and last-seen and creation timestamps.

Coder from 2.0.0 before 2.34.8 contains an open redirect vulnerability in handleAPIKeySmuggling that allows attackers to redirect users externally via unsanitized r.URL.Path values. Attackers can craft links on trusted workspace app subdomains with paths beginning with double slashes, which become scheme-relative redirects to attacker sites for phishing.

Coder before 2.29.17, 2.30.0 before 2.32.7, 2.33.0 before 2.33.8, and 2.34.0 before 2.34.2 contains a stored HTML injection vulnerability because the ApplicationName and LogoURL appearance settings are rendered into HTML output without sufficient escaping. Attackers with the Owner role can store HTML markup in these settings that renders in the Coder dashboard and in SMTP notification emails sent to other deployment users.

Coder before 2.29.17, 2.30.0 before 2.32.7, 2.33.0 before 2.33.8, and 2.34.0 before 2.34.2 contains a user enumeration vulnerability because userpassword.Compare() substitutes a placeholder hash derived from the string "hunter2" when a stored password hash is empty. Unauthenticated attackers can submit logins with the password "hunter2" and distinguish HTTP 403 from 401 responses to enumerate valid accounts and reveal the authentication provider of SSO-only users.

Coder before 2.34.7 contains an IP spoofing vulnerability in the ExtractRealIPAddress middleware that trusts the leftmost, client-supplied X-Forwarded-For value instead of the client IP appended by a reverse proxy. Attackers can send forged X-Forwarded-For values through appending proxies to bypass per-IP rate limits on login, one-time passcode, and password validation endpoints, enabling brute-force attacks, and to falsify IP addresses recorded in audit logs.

A security flaw has been discovered in THU-MIG yoloe up to 40cd606cabdbe2b566d6f14a6b162c89206e9a1b. This affects the function eval of the file ultralytics/nn/autobackend.py of the component AutoBackend Model Loading. The manipulation of the argument imgsz/names/kpt_shape results in improper neutralization of directives in dynamically evaluated code. The attack requires a local approach. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. This product does not use versioning. This is why information about affected and unaffected releases are unavailable. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

A weakness has been identified in nemoTyrant manong up to 7c9e5228e133b9267ad3a415833bc9bb53193bb4. This impacts the function cache/del_cache/arr2sql of the file func.php. This manipulation causes sql injection. The attack may be initiated remotely. This product uses a rolling release model to deliver continuous updates. However, it was not possible to determine the PR or commit which could have fixed this issue.

A vulnerability was determined in datastax pulsar-jms up to 9.0.3. This issue affects the function decode of the file pulsar-jms/src/main/java/com/datastax/oss/pulsar/jms/messages/PulsarObjectMessage.java. This manipulation causes deserialization. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

ip-address before 10.7.4 allows a denial of service (CPU consumption from quadratic complexity, and application stall) via many % characters in input reaching a function call that uses the Address6 constructor.

A vulnerability was identified in makeplane plane up to 1.4.2. Impacted is an unknown function of the component API Endpoint. Such manipulation of the argument X-Forwarded-For leads to reliance on untrusted inputs in a security decision. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.
